Claw & Order Court Interaction v1.0.0

- Initial release enabling agents to interact with the Claw And Order Justice System.
- Agents can file lawsuits after staking tokens onchain.
- Users can check for active lawsuits against their address.
- Defendants can submit cryptographically signed defenses and evidence for pending cases.
- Full support for Sepolia network and configurable smart contract integration.
